name: Prayer
overview: Prayer in Scripture is portrayed as the heartfelt communication between believers and God, exemplified by Abraham's intimate dialogue with the Lord as he intercedes for the righteous (Genesis 18:23) and his act of calling upon God's name in worship (Genesis 12:8). It reveals the believer's dependence on God's mercy and blessing, as seen in Ishmael's promised fruitfulness through God's hearing (Genesis 17:20), and expresses honest confession of personal burden, like Cain's lament over his punishment (Genesis 4:13). This biblical pattern underscores prayer as a vital spiritual practice rooted in relationship, trust, and the seeking of God's will.
